fusions.name: Run Down the Wounded
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. A snapping dart deals 18 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally beside you, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Many Mouths
fusions.desc: Tears into everything around you, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, and you and your allies strike 20% harder for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Snapping Pack
fusions.desc: Calls a pack of dogfish that fights for 10 seconds, biting an enemy within 5 tiles for 4 damage every second.

fusions.name: Holding the Scent
fusions.desc: You deal 10% more damage to enemies carrying your afflictions.
